title: Design System: Caja rápida — Simulación M/M/1

components.name: Flap Cell
components.description: Live metric value on the departures board.
components.css: .ds-flap { display: inline-block; min-width: 5.6rem; padding: 0.18rem 0.5rem 0.05rem; background: #2e2b1c; color: #ffc20e; border-radius: 3px; font: 700 1.5rem/1.2 Overpass, sans-serif; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Scenario Gate
components.description: Selects a guide scenario; active state is yellow.
components.css: .ds-gate { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.8rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.55rem 1rem 0.55rem 0.55rem; background: #ffc20e; color: #16171a; border: 2px solid #ffc20e; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 1.15rem Overpass, sans-serif; } .ds-gate .n { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.8rem; height: 2.8rem; background: #16171a; color: #ffc20e; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.9rem; }

narrative.northStar: The checkout signposted like an airport
narrative.overview: Pictogram customers, flat black signage and a departures board replay the SimPy records on a cool terminal-gray wall, legible from the back of a classroom.
keyCharacteristics: Three signal colors with one meaning each

rules.name: One meaning per signal color
rules.body: Yellow is now, green is leaving/free, red is saturation only.

rules.name: Numbers big, words few
rules.body: Readable numbers never go below 1.3rem; explanatory text stays on one line.

dos: Drive every movement from SimPy records
donts: No cards, gradients, glow or offset shadows
No dark page ground or neon accents
